1. Install Boson Identity on the new phone.
2. There, choose \"I already have one\", then \"Move from my old phone\", and choose your home node.
2. There, choose \"I already have one\", then \"Move from my old phone\", and choose your home node, %1$s.
3. The new phone shows a code and asks for your identity\'s key. On this phone, in Devices, tap \"Approve a new device\", scan the code and approve it.
Your key reaches the new phone sealed to its code: the node can\'t read it. Keep this phone until the new one works. If you can\'t, restore the new phone from your key\'s backup instead.
Deletes this identity\'s keys from this phone and signs it out of the node. Your account on the node stays.
Its key will be deleted from this phone. Only your backup of the key can bring this identity back. Your account on the node is not deleted.
You haven\'t backed up this identity\'s key. If you remove it, the identity is lost forever: no one, not even the node, can bring it back.
To confirm, type the first 4 characters of its ID: %1$s
